initial_conditions: The previous Debian ARM64 release has seven unresolved entries among 234 emitted Cargo crates, and the exact locked archives are cached.
actions: Package the current studio and CLI offline on Debian ARM64.
Read the final package manifest, every staged file, seven locked archive digests and their VCS metadata.
Compare the earlier package manifest and all earlier file digests.
expected_outcomes: The offline package includes matching license files and provenance for all seven, its package ledger verifies every file, and the previous package retains all original digests.
